bagPolicy.summary: The Pavilion at Star Lake does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: General admission parking is free with your ticket and opens 2 hours before gate time. Premier and Reserved Parking are available for purchase and offer easier access but do not guarantee early exit.

rideshare.note: Uber/Lyft/Ride Share services are available with drop off along Route 18.

concessions.note: The Pavilion at Star Lake offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Shop's NY-inspired pizzas. Koko's Bavarian provides German-inspired sausages and pretzels, while general concessions offer popcorn, nachos, and a selection of beverages. CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream is available in convenient pouches.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by The Pavilion at Star Lake, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in The Pavilion at Star Lake's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at The Pavilion at Star Lake. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at The Pavilion at Star Lake. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
